# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration cand_0010. Parent/champion = cand_0003 (val 0.637). prompt.md and
task_template.md are BYTE-IDENTICAL to cand_0003 — I ship **no capability edit** this
iteration, because a fresh, gold-verified re-diagnosis of all 33 failing tasks found
**zero** that admit a fix passing all three tests (REAL + SAFE + VERIFIED). Shipping a
speculative edit here has negative expected value (see the structural argument below) and
would only re-perturb the noise-flip cluster — the exact failure mode of cand_0004–0009.

## Method this iteration
Fanned out **3 parallel read-only subagents**, one per third of the 33 failing tasks. Each
read the trajectory (instruction + emitted code + grader feedback) AND the ground-truth
answer files at `…/spreadsheetbench-data/all_data_912_v0.1/spreadsheet/<id>/`
(`N_<id>_answer.xlsx`, N=1/2/3), diffed input→gold on all 3 instances, and classified each
task as GRADER/ENV FAULT · COMPREHENSION · FIXABLE. Each was given the full list of rules
already in the prompt and the list of refuted levers, and told to call a task FIXABLE only
if a general, non-answer-leaking rule reproduces gold on ALL 3 instances.

## Result of the re-diagnosis (all 33 failing tasks)
- **GRADER / ENV / STALE-GOLD / VOLATILE-DATE faults (unwinnable by any prompt edit) — ~16:**
  34-5 (frozen date-dependent gold; agent output byte-matches gold yet 0/3), 250-20 (inst2
  gold contains rows absent from its input + mis-sums duplicates), 269-44 (gold
  self-contradictory across near-identical instances), 30930 (inst2 cached gold contradicts
  its own formula), 32023 (volatile TODAY()), 14207 (infra recalc failure + openpyxl
  rich-text bug — feedback says "Not a prompt defect"), 413-15 (gold TOTAL is an uncached
  formula reading as None), 4225 (gold casing contradicts the instruction's own example),
  48983 (gold silently fixes a typo'd row header), 49782 (literal `' '` vs empty
  type-strictness; instruction says empty is fine), 50526 (gold expects a value absent from
  the data / hand-edited source), 53062 (string "1" vs numeric 1 — already covered by
  numbers-as-numbers), 53305 (inst2 gold has 3 stray dragged-formula 0s), 55258 (gold sums
  ALL values = 450/550/650, contradicting the instruction's own stated $200), 58890 (input
  RO column differs from the data gold was computed on), 45944 (recalc fault — grader fails
  even code that reproduces gold's cached values).
- **COMPREHENSION misreads with NO safe general rule — ~15:** 10281, 146-49 (pair SET is
  identical to gold; fails only on an UNSTATED alphabetical row-sort — order-sensitive
  grader), 157-4 (correct F:L emptiness scope derivable only from the embedded broken
  macro), 254-34 (subset-sum + VBA-source→value, refuted), 32468 (task-specific EOMONTH
  window), 32975 (gold's idiosyncratic MAX(B)×current-C contradicts the literal
  instruction), 398-14 (gold writes numeric 0 where the instruction literally says show a
  hyphen — contradicts the spec; refuted-adjacent to dash-as-zero), 39946 (intricate
  revenue-recognition formula), 50755 (positional-not-ranked, already in prompt line 22 —
  known-but-broken, not a knowledge gap), 53449, 55039, 55912, 58484, 6698, 577-40 &
  585-41 (both re-confirm previously-REFUTED rules).
- **FIXABLE that passes REAL+SAFE+VERIFIED: 0.**

## The two candidates that looked FIXABLE, and why each was DROPPED
| task | proposed rule | test it fails | reasoning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 45944 | "resolve a named Excel table (`Table1[...]`) to its defined range, don't use a look-alike block" | **REAL** | Verified reproduces gold's *cached* values, but the grader still returns 0/3 — the real failure is the recalc/infra fault the journal already logged. Not a prompt defect. |
| 42930 | "if the input has a helper column/table mapping keys→the requested output values, look it up instead of re-deriving" | **SAFE** | Directly CONFLICTS with the load-bearing anti-copy rule ("Never copy values out of an existing answer/sample/desired region — reproduce the logic"). Teaching the weaker reader to tell a legitimate input mapping-table from a sample/desired region it must NOT copy is UNBOUNDED — it risks the ~25 passing tasks that legitimately recompute (253-22→13282, 347-49→856, 567-21→120, 105-24→20…). 42930 was also PASSING at seed and broke under cand_0001 → a noise-flip member, not a stable convertible target. If the instruction names E:F explicitly it's a known-but-broken skip (prose can't fix); if not, it's comprehension (unsafe to encode). Either branch fails a test. |

## Why NO speculative edit is the correct action (structural, not timidity)
1. **The champion is a frozen high-variance lucky draw.** cand_0007 was BYTE-IDENTICAL to
   the champion prompt and re-scored **0.549 (Δ −0.088)**, "breaking" 8 tasks. So the exact
   champion behavior re-scores ~0.088 BELOW its recorded 0.637; the true mean is ~0.55–0.58
   and 0.637 was a lucky high draw locked in as champion.
2. **The gate compares a noisy re-score against that frozen 0.637 + a significance bar.**
   With a ~±0.088 noise floor and a mean near 0.56, essentially no candidate — including the
   true-best prompt — can clear 0.637 reliably. The run has CONVERGED.
3. **Corollary that kills the last untried lever (consolidation/shortening).** Reducing
   reader variance would make a lucky draw ABOVE 0.637 *less* likely, not more — so trimming
   the prompt is strictly counterproductive against a frozen lucky-high bar. It is also
   UNBOUNDED (58 passing tasks depend on the current wording). Do not attempt it.
4. Every prompt edit perturbs the reader's stochastic behavior on the recurring noise cluster
   (347-49, 47699, 50486, 50682, 53957, 55224, 56561, 31420, 36478, 267-18…), whose flips
   (±several tasks) dominate any 0/1-task gain available. cand_0004–0009 each demonstrated
   this: 6 straight rejections, broke-sets that heavily overlap that cluster and the no-op's.

## Confirmed-SAFE checks
- prompt.md and task_template.md are unchanged from champion cand_0003; all six required
  placeholders + `{max_turns}` remain intact in task_template.md; no infra/adapter/harness/
  scorer/benchmark file was touched; no shell command mutated the environment.

## Process & features used
- 3 parallel `general-purpose` subagents for the gold-verified fan-out (groups A/B/C of the
  33 failing tasks). Read the system-prompt SKILL (lever menu), diagnose SKILL, and all four
  cross-iteration files (LEDGER, JOURNAL, RUNMAP, prior PROCESS) before deciding.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not regress in a future iteration)
- cand_0001–0003's load-bearing blocks: RE-RUN/generalization, composite-key/contiguous-run
  boundaries, run-to-completion+always-save, reproduce-operation-exactly, blank-vs-zero,
  use-embedded-examples, type/format. These earned +0.022/+0.011/+0.066.
- Do NOT ban formulas globally (8 passing scalar-formula tasks). Do NOT re-tighten verify
  item (a) (399-14). Do NOT add a "use the provided lookup table" rule (conflicts with the
  anti-copy rule; see 42930 above).

## Deliberately skipped + recommendation
- All 33 failing tasks: none admit a REAL+SAFE+VERIFIED fix (re-verified against gold this
  iteration). The residual is entirely (a) grader/recalc/stale-gold/volatile-date
  infrastructure the optimizer may not edit, and (b) task-specific comprehension misreads no
  safe general rule can encode without leaking an answer.
- **Recommendation to a human:** conclude the run at cand_0003. The remaining gains live
  OUTSIDE the prompt — pin the grading reference date, fix/refresh the stale & self-
  contradictory gold (250-20, 269-44, 30930, 50526, 53305, 55258, 58890, 4225, 34-5),
  relax grader type-strictness (numeric-vs-string, `' '`-vs-empty, uncached-formula totals),
  and/or lower reader temperature to shrink the ±0.088 noise floor.
